data.title: Office Lobby and Building Facilities
data.summary: Realistic office lobby, reception, lifts, stairs, corridors, washrooms, comms rooms, staff amenities and building facilities.
data.description: A modern realistic building circulation and back-of-house library for commercial office interiors: reception desks and lobby seating, security speedgates, lift landings and car interiors, escalators, stairs and balustrades, corridor and washroom wall modules, WC cubicles and sanitaryware, comms racks, cable ladder and cooling, staff kitchenettes, canteens and lockers, cleaning and post room equipment, and wayfinding. Corridor-family modules are 1.2 m runs 2.6 m tall with run-left and run-right connectors; washroom walls are 1 m runs 2.6 m tall and 100 mm thick with wall-left, wall-right and a corner carrying wall-back; WC cubicles pitch at 900 mm, servery counters at 600 mm, 19-inch racks at 600 mm, cable ladder and ceiling rafts and balustrades at 1.2 m. Lift leaves, cubicle and locker doors, rack doors, the fire door and a lifted raised floor tile are named nodes pivoted on their hinge or slide axes, and each leaf, flap, lid and drawer ships a rigid open and close clip on that pivot, with a turning clip on the turnstile tripod: node transforms only, no skinning. Every file is self-contained CC0 geometry with no collision or navigation data.
